summary: Embecta Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of Owen Mumford Holdings Limited, a UK-based medical device maker, for an upfront cash payment of £100 million (~$126M USD) plus up to £50 million in contingent milestone payments tied to sales of the Aidaptus auto-injector through June 2029. The deal closed on May 15, 2026, under a purchase agreement dated March 19, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is cited. Embecta expects to file financial statements and pro forma information within 71 days. Watch for milestone achievement updates, which affect total consideration.
